_note: The Finnish school calendar (GDD 4.9.3; research session D1, 2026-10-17; read by the school model S1). Dates are ISO (YYYY-MM-DD). `verified` blocks are copied from the pages in `sources` (read 2026-10-17); `rules` make the later school years and are ALL `estimated` (the dates of a year that is not published yet are our rule, never a promise). Municipalities decide their own breaks, so the table `municipal` holds what 20 of the game's towns published for 2026-27 and the rest of the 84 towns (data/towns.json) fall back on `rules.winter_break` by region and `rules.autumn_break` week 42. Lukio calendars differ by school: `lukio_example` is ONE real school (Helsingin kielilukio, 5 periods); other schools have 6 periods (Muurame and Kauhava per GDD 4.9.8), so S1 uses the example's shape as the rule. The game starts Monday 2 Nov 2026 (period 2 of the example).

national.note: The agency says the list is indicative and that each municipality publishes its own dates. Easter is not mentioned on its page. Page of 2026-04-10.

lukio_example.exam_week_note: The school calls the last week of a period 'päättöviikko'; each runs seven school days (weekends skipped) and ends on the last day of its period (period 5: on 3 June, two days before the end). Single tests of the lukio courses are not published.

matriculation.note: Dates of the Matriculation Examination Board (YTL). The board marks both sessions provisional ('alustavia'); exams start at 9:00 at every upper secondary school. The groups use the board's subject groups.

groups.mother_tongue_reading: Finnish / Swedish mother tongue and literature: reading skills test
groups.mother_tongue_writing: Finnish / Swedish mother tongue and literature: writing skills test
groups.finnish_as_second_language: Finnish or Swedish as a second language and literature
groups.finnish_as_second_language_reading: Finnish as a second language: reading and listening comprehension part
groups.finnish_as_second_language_writing: Finnish as a second language: writing skills part
groups.foreign_long: Foreign language, long syllabus (English, French, Spanish, German, Russian)
groups.foreign_short: Foreign language, short syllabus (English, French, Spanish, German, Russian, Italian, Portuguese, Latin, Sami)
groups.second_national: Second national language, long and intermediate syllabus
groups.realia_a: Realia: psychology, philosophy, history, physics, biology
groups.realia_b: Realia: religion, ethics, social studies, chemistry, geography, health education

camps.note: VERIFIED in session S2 (2026-10-17) from the brochure itself: the Pajulahti campus's 'Yläkoululeiritys, Yleisurheilu' for grades 7-9 (SUL's athletics coaching centre; the Kolmen kampuksen urheiluopisto). FOUR camps, Mon-Fri, in school weeks (the GDD 4.9.8 note of 2026-10-11 had three: the March camp was missing). 355 EUR a camp, full board, 2-6 bed rooms; the night before (Sun-Mon) 58 EUR extra; a materials pack 10 EUR a season; apply by 2026-08-31, SUL's sport officials choose from the applications; the athlete and the family commit to EVERY camp of the season. On full camp days the pupils study under supervision (at least 3 x 45 min) and tests and work-experience periods that fall in the camp week can be taken at the camp. The 2026-27 camps were applied for before the career starts (2 Nov 2026), so S2 shows them on the Calendar as information only; the camps as a feature (applying, being picked, the camp week) wait for the camp-week session (GDD 4.9.6 no. 4). Later years' dates are NOT published: never invent them.

rules.note: How S1 makes a school year that is not published. Each rule was fitted to 2026-27 (the examples show it reproduces the real dates) and is marked `estimated` for every later year. Public holidays outside the term (Midsummer) are not needed.

school_start.check: 2026: Wednesday 12 Aug (the agency: week 33, usually 12 or 13 Aug)

autumn_break.rule: ISO week 42 (Monday to Friday); towns in the municipal table keep their published week (43 in Kotka, Kouvola, Lahti, Lappeenranta, Mikkeli, Oulu and Pori in 2026)

christmas_break.rule: 22 December to 6 January (Saturdays and Sundays inside count as free)
christmas_break.note: In 2026-27 the first free day was 20-23 Dec by town; the agency says the break is most often 22 Dec - 6 Jan.

winter_break.rule: Monday to Friday of ISO week 8 (south), 9 (middle) or 10 (north and east) by the group of the town's maakunta (data/towns.json winter_groups)

easter.rule: Good Friday to Easter Monday (Easter Sunday by the usual church calculation)

other_holidays.rule: Ascension Thursday (39 days after Easter Sunday) and the Friday after it as a free day
6 December (Independence Day, always a holiday; Sunday in 2026)

lukio_periods.note: Offsets from the first school day, fitted to the Helsingin kielilukio calendar of 2026-27 (periods 12 Aug, 5 Oct, 2 Dec, 10 Feb, 14 Apr; end 5 Jun). Other lukio have 6 periods: S1 decides how to treat them.

spring_start.rule: the first Tuesday on or after 10 March
spring_start.check: 2026: Tue 10 Mar, 2027: Tue 16 Mar (a 2026 date from a 2026 search summary, not from the board's page)

autumn_start.rule: the first Monday on or after 12 September

matriculation.note: The board rotates the order of the subject groups from year to year; the offsets are the 2027 (spring) and 2026 (autumn) patterns used for every later year. A session is usually spread over 3 weeks; a student takes the required exams over at most THREE consecutive sessions, also in a 4-year lukio (the board's page, read 2026-10-17 in session S3b: data/lukio.json src 2; the earlier note '4 in a 4-year urheilulukio' was wrong: a 4th session only retakes).

not_verified: Kerava's and Porvoo's own 2026-27 breaks (not in the agency's table; their pages were not found).
Single tests (kokeet) of yläkoulu and lukio courses: no national or school-wide dates are published; S1 makes them by rule.
The lukio calendar of any school but Helsingin kielilukio (6-period schools such as Muurame and Kauhava are only known from GDD 4.9.8).
The Pajulahti camps of 2027-28 and later (the brochure covers 2026-27 only; see camps).
The rule values for 2027-28 and later years (everything under `rules`).
